texts: Our customer Vellum Ferryworks has renewed its support agreement with us; the agreement identifies that company as the buyer of our service.
For the equipment we are selling, the buyer is Cress Harbor Instruments. Nacre Lantern Cooperative supplies our packing materials and has never been our customer.
The company Brindle Reed Systems is solely our supplier. It has never purchased anything from us and is not our client.
Contrary to the draft note, Garnet Loam Association has never been our customer; the final record explicitly marks the organization as a non-customer.
In this glossary, 'client', 'buyer', and 'customer organization' describe business roles. The examples name no particular organization.
A sheaf is a bundle of cut stalks. A company whose registered name is sheaf is our current client.
We finished our last paid assignment for Juniper Trestle Bureau several years ago. That organization was our customer then, although it is no longer our customer today.
Pumice Thread Alliance, an incorporated organization, released a handbook. This note provides no information about whether that organization is or ever was a customer of ours.
我们正在为霁岸测绘社提供付费运维，双方合同明确写明该组织是本公司的客户。
本公司销售的这批仪器由砾舟检具合作社购买，它是本单买方；泊榆纸品厂只向我们供货，从未成为我们的客户。
青穗陶轮有限公司只承担我们的原料供应，合同还明确注明它不是本公司的客户。
纪要中曾误写岚坞装配协会是我们的客户，核定结论是否定的：该组织从来不是我们的客户。
这里的“客户单位”“供应商”“买方”都是角色类别，不是在给某家机构命名；整段没有写出具体组织名称。
登记记录写明，一家组织的实际名称就是“折页”，它是我们的现有客户；随后工艺说明中的“折页”只指纸张加工步骤。
藏芦线缆社曾购买过本公司的检测服务，是我们过去的客户；双方后来终止合作，目前已经没有客户关系。
羽汀纹样会作为一个组织在展览目录中被介绍，目录只讲它的作品，没有交代它是否与本公司存在过客户关系。
